subject: Copywriting
title: CIA and Cultural Propaganda
description: Learn CIA and Cultural Propaganda in one minute.

hook.text: The CIA secretly funded literary magazines, art exhibitions, and jazz tours. Culture was a weapon in the war of ideas.

buildup.text: The Congress for Cultural Freedom, covertly funded by the CIA, promoted Western art and intellectualism across Europe.

discovery.text: Abstract expressionism was promoted to contrast Soviet realism. Jackson Pollock's chaos symbolized freedom.

twist.text: When the CIA funding was exposed in 1967, artists felt betrayed.

climax.text: Cultural propaganda is the subtlest form: it doesn't feel like persuasion.

punchline.text: Jazz tours funded by spies. Culture is the quietest propaganda of all.

quiz.question: Which art movement did the CIA covertly promote?
